changelog: - **A MARKETING demo tenant behind the shipped funnel preset** (#2443, story #2398). `npm run seed:demo` seeded exactly one organization and never set `vertical`, so every demo row was an INTERNSHIP tenant and the `MARKETING_FUNNEL` stage preset (#2353) had nothing at all behind it — the marketing board, funnel, ageing and drop-off screens rendered perfectly with zero rows on every demo, topic environment and contributor's box. The seeder now adds a second organization (`demo-marketing`, `vertical: 'MARKETING'`, PRO) with the preset's own `PipelineStage` rows (LEAD_NEW … DEAL_LOST, trial pair included), a tenant admin, three account owners and thirty synthetic German merchant accounts on the existing `Company` model — each with a lead `User` and a `MentorshipRelation` funnel record per docs/marketing-vertical/pipeline-record.md, spread across all nine stages, with 94 back-dated `StatusChange` rows and 61 `InteractionLog` rows so stage ageing and the analytics curves have a shape to draw. New `prisma/seed-demo-marketing.mjs`; the stage list is a plain-ESM mirror of the preset because the seeder runs in the runtime image (node:20-slim, no `src/`), and `scripts/test/marketing-demo-tenant.test.mjs` fails the build if the mirror and `defaultTemplateForVertical('MARKETING')` ever disagree. The tenant admin and the three owners sign in with the usual demo password; the lead people carry `NO_LOGIN_PASSWORD` (the same sentinel the marketing importer writes), so they are records rather than thirty sign-in-able MENTEE accounts in a vertical that has no mentee portal. Six marketing-scoped entries added to `scripts/demo-fidelity.json`; the seeder stays idempotent and `assertSafeDemoTarget()` still refuses a non-local database.
